subject: Post-demo buying committee: decision criteria, legal checklist & onboarding plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@greenleafhealth.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@greenleafhealth.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo buying committee: decision criteria, legal checklist & onboarding plan

Hi Julia, Tom, Amit —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our 45-minute demo and a proposed next-step plan so we can keep momentum with the committee. I’ve attached the demo deck and our SOC 2 summary for your legal/security review.

Key outcomes from today
- Economic buyer: Julia confirmed finance is leading budget/approval (target approver: Julia Ramos).
- Security & legal owners: Tom (IT/Security) + Amit (Legal) will own the technical and contract review.
- Procurement: procurement@greenleafhealth.com will handle PO/payment terms and standard wording.
- Primary decision criteria you articulated: predictable per-token unit economics, PII data handling (in-region options), and an onboarding plan with an initial 2-week pilot + SLO targets.

Open items / asks (action owners and suggested due dates)
1) Security packet: we attached a short SOC 2 summary. Tom/Amit — can you confirm if you need the full SOC 2 report or a white-glove package (e.g., network diagrams, DST)? Reply by EOD Thu (2026-06-19) if possible.
2) Commercial model: Julia — we’ll send a 12-month consumption example and pilot pricing by Fri (2026-06-19). Please confirm the finance cadence for approvals.
3) Legal redlines: Amit — we’ll share a draft SOW and standard T&Cs; tag any high-priority clauses (data residency, indemnity, audit rights).
4) Procurement specifics: Vanessa (me) will follow up with procurement@greenleafhealth.com to confirm PO templates and billing contact.

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute check-in to align procurement + legal on Mon 2026-06-22 at 10:00 AM PT. Let me know if that works for your teams.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

---
Notes: demo showed: autoscaling/dedicated pools, prefix caching to reduce token costs, and role-based access controls. Pilot can be scoped to 50k tokens/day for 2 weeks.
From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@greenleafhealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: 2026-06-18T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo buying committee: decision criteria, legal checklist & onboarding plan

Thanks Vanessa — good demo. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Tom/Amit: please confirm whether the SOC 2 summary is sufficient to start procurement, or if you need the full attestation and encrypt-at-rest details.
- Vanessa / Redwood: can you provide an example 12-month run-rate and a pilot pricing worksheet that clearly shows the difference between hosted vs. private deployment costs? Julia: finance will need both line items.
- Procurement: we typically require vendor onboarding forms and a redline of any non-standard indemnity or data-use clauses.

Tom, Amit — looping you for intake. If you need specific network diagrams or a data flow map to evaluate egress controls, let Vanessa know.

Would it be possible to start the procurement packet this week so we can target a decision by mid-July?

Best,
Julia Ramos
VP Finance — Greenleaf Health
julia.ramos@greenleafhealth.com | +1 202-555-0147

Subject: Re: Post-demo buying committee: decision criteria, legal checklist & onboarding plan

Julia — thanks for the quick reply. Attaching the SOC 2 summary (same doc Vanessa attached) and a short technical FAQ that includes: encryption at rest/in transit, key management options (KMS/HSM integrations), and an example data flow for our hosted offering. Also attaching a draft SOW that reflects a 2-week pilot scope.

Quick answers to the items you called out:
- Full SOC 2: we can provide the full attestation under NDA. If you want the auditor report and complementary controls, flag that and Amit we’ll route through secure file transfer.
- Hosted vs Private pricing: attached SOW includes an appendix with pilot pricing (hosted pilot at lighter cost, private deployment has one-time infra setup). Vanessa will follow up with the 12-month run-rate examples.
- Network diagrams: see the data-flow diagram in the technical FAQ attachment. If your network team wants a deep-dive we can schedule a 20-minute architecture review next week.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, draft-statement-of-work.docx, redwood-technical-faq.pdf

Regards,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0083

Julia / Procurement team —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick operational plan to keep us on track: 
- Today (18 Jun): Redwood provided SOC2 summary + draft SOW and technical FAQ (Ben).
- Fri (19 Jun): Redwood to deliver 12-month run-rate and pilot pricing (Vanessa).
- Mon (22 Jun): 30-min alignment call (procurement + legal + Redwood) — proposed 10:00 AM PT. Meeting invite to follow.
- Wed (24 Jun): Procurement provides initial redlines and vendor onboarding checklist.
- Target decision: mid-July (preferred week of Jul 13)

Marissa here — I’ll coordinate the pilot onboarding checklist and make sure the technical review is scheduled with your network team. If procurement wants specific vendor forms (W9, vendor questionnaire), please send them to procurement@greenleafhealth.com and cc me so I can track.

Next steps for Redwood (action items):
- Vanessa: send a 12-month pricing run-rate and pilot worksheet by Fri 2026-06-19.
- Ben: prepare a short architecture deep-dive (20 min) for the network/security team next week.
- Marissa: send calendar invite for Mon 2026-06-22 at 10:00 AM PT.

Looking forward — we’ll keep this tight.

Best,
Marissa Cole
